_comment: Rolling stock parameters. Every entry carries a `status` field:
published  - stated directly by the operator or a reference compilation
derived    - computed from published values by an explicit formula
modelled   - not publicly available at usable precision; estimated, basis given
This tagging is load-bearing for the README. Do not add a parameter without it.

E235-0.designation: JR East E235 series, 0 subseries (Yamanote Line)

tare_mass_t.source: ja.wikipedia JR東日本E235系電車 (編成重量)
tare_mass_t.note: Tare (empty). Loaded mass is computed separately from capacity and a per-passenger mass assumption.

capacity_passengers.source: ja.wikipedia JR東日本E235系電車 (編成定員)
capacity_passengers.conflict: en.wikipedia gives 1628 for the same formation. JA figure used; discrepancy recorded, not resolved.

passenger_mass_kg.basis: Conventional Japanese rolling stock design figure for AW loading calculations.

traction_motor.description: Toshiba totally-enclosed fan-cooled 3-phase AC induction motor

total_power_kw.formula: 6 motor cars x 4 motors x 140 kW
total_power_kw.note: One-hour rating, not continuous rating. Continuous rating is not published; using the one-hour figure makes the model marginally optimistic in the constant-power region.

max_operating_speed_kmh.source: ja.wikipedia; matches the Yamanote Line speed limit
max_operating_speed_kmh.note: Line limit and stock limit coincide here. Design maximum is 120 km/h.

starting_acceleration_kmh_s.source: ja.wikipedia JR東日本E235系電車 (起動加速度)
starting_acceleration_kmh_s.note: Net acceleration achieved at start, i.e. already includes running resistance at v=0. Load condition for this figure is not stated; assumed AW2.

service_deceleration_kmh_s.source: ja.wikipedia JR東日本E235系電車 (減速度)
service_deceleration_kmh_s.note: This is the maximum service brake rate (常用最大). Normal station approaches use less. Modelling every stop at 4.2 gives a genuine lower bound on run time, which is what the validation wants.

regenerative_braking.source: ja.wikipedia (回生ブレーキ併用電気指令式ブレーキ)

body_height_mm.note: Height above rail, used only to estimate frontal area.

rotational_inertia_lambda.basis: Standard range for an EMU is 0.06-0.10; 0.08 taken as midpoint. Not published for this class. Effective mass = m * (1 + lambda). Omitting this term would make the train roughly 8 percent too quick.
rotational_inertia_lambda.sensitivity: Sweep 0.06-0.10 and report the run-time spread in the README.

adhesive_mass_fraction.basis: 6 of 11 cars are powered (6/11 = 0.545). Assumes uniform mass per car, which is not exactly true since motor cars are heavier. This makes the adhesion ceiling a conservative (low) estimate.
adhesive_mass_fraction.note: With 24 powered axles the adhesion limit does not bind for this class under normal conditions. Included for correctness and for the fleet comparison, where it does bind for locomotive-hauled stock.

davis_coefficients.basis: Published Davis coefficients for the E235 are not available. Japanese operators use per-class coefficient sets that are not released. Values here are estimated from mass, car count and frontal area. See resistance.py for the estimator and its assumptions.
davis_coefficients.warning: This is the single largest modelled uncertainty in the physics core. Treat any run-time agreement as conditional on it.
